name: Evil Spirits
overview: Scripture reveals that evil spirits are real adversaries who seek to harm and destroy, as the thief comes to steal, kill, and destroy, contrasting with Christ's purpose to give abundant life (John 10:10). Believers are empowered through Jesus' name to overcome these forces, having authority even over demonic powers (Luke 10:17, 10:19). Living under God's protection provides safety from such evil (Psalms 91:1), and Christians are called to resist evil, overcoming it with good rather than being overcome themselves (Romans 12:21). God’s holiness also calls His people to avoid practices associated with evil influences, such as marking the body for the dead (Leviticus 19:28).
